findings.reason: the done-when requires exactly one heading walker in the package, so the section must fold reckon/_store.py:1750, :1776 and :1779 into the enumerator (or state why they are not the same walk) or its own census cannot pass.
findings.text: §16's census of heading walkers ("four spellings": the mcp_views soup walk, the landed_section_ids regex walk, and the two doccheck soup walks) omits three further h2-id walks inside its own target module: reckon/_store.py:1750 (`BeautifulSoup(html_text, "html.parser").find_all("h2", id=True)` in the section-record attachment check), reckon/_store.py:1776 (`before.find_all("h2", id=True)`) and reckon/_store.py:1779 (`after.find_all("h2", id=re.compile(r"^s[0-9]+$"))` in _require_new_section_contracts); the plan names only landed_section_ids, the MCP view and both doccheck walks for rewriting, so the extra three survive the change while the done-when ("counts the heading walkers in the package and requires one") would report a violation the described consolidation never addresses

findings.reason: the interface the consolidating module hides behind must be stated, or mcp_views keeps its own walk and the "one enumerator" goal is not met.
findings.text: §16 says _authored_section_headings is "rewritten to call" the single enumerator, but that enumerator is specified to "yield each authored section's identity, heading and replaced span" as offsets into raw text, whereas mcp_views._authored_section_headings returns (identity, Tag) and its sole caller traverses the Tag's soup siblings (mcp_views.py:2228, `selected.next_siblings`), and in the wrapper-id case the heading Tag carries no id of its own to look up by identity — so the plan leaves either a second soup walk (defeating "one enumerator") or an unstated raw-text-to-Tag reconciliation

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the "one enumerator" is specified as a raw-text regex span producer, but the MCP consumer it claims to absorb needs a BeautifulSoup heading Tag that the span interface cannot yield for the wrapper-id case.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16 enumerates four heading walkers to consolidate, but reckon/_store.py itself carries three more h2-id walks that the consolidation list does not name.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1475, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 names its one added public definition and states why nothing can be retired (the identity digest and the prose walk keep their names and gain a mode) and why no refusal family is added (the plan-review-missing family is reused and names the uncovered sections in its detail).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §16 cites and extends named owners rather than adding a subsystem: plan_fingerprint and _authored_prose in reckon/crew/plan_review.py, _fingerprint_forms, and the _section_heading/_section_body_end/_collapse_authored_section/landed_section_ids quartet in reckon/_store.py, all of which exist and match the described shapes.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the coverage predicate the gate and sweep read computes a per-section coverage verdict rather than forwarding to an existing call; _fingerprint_forms is extended in place rather than wrapped.
